minimum_evidence: Public or customer-accessible current OpenAPI document with version and server URL
live_test: Load the contract in a validator and reconcile documented operations with the vendor's API reference.

minimum_evidence: Named API owner; supported versions; complete endpoint and method inventory
live_test: Select five representative workflows and map each required operation to a documented endpoint.

minimum_evidence: Published notice period; changelog; version retirement process
live_test: Trace one prior breaking change from announcement through replacement guidance.

minimum_evidence: Service or integration identity that does not reuse a technician account
live_test: Create a dedicated identity; authenticate; disable it; prove access stops.

minimum_evidence: Operation-level scope documentation and separable read/write permissions
live_test: Grant read-only access and confirm a representative write is denied.

minimum_evidence: Documented tenant model and object-level authorization behavior
live_test: Attempt authorized and unauthorized cross-tenant object access in a safe test environment.

minimum_evidence: Documented list and detail operations with stable identifiers
live_test: Retrieve a customer; its sites; and endpoints; then reconcile counts and identifiers with the console.

minimum_evidence: Documented alert fields; filters; states; timestamps; and ownership
live_test: Retrieve active alerts and reconcile severity; state; endpoint; and timestamps with the console.

minimum_evidence: Documented write scope; validation; authorization; and observable result
live_test: Perform one authorized reversible write in a test tenant and independently verify the final state.

minimum_evidence: Cursor or page semantics; stable ordering; updated-since or equivalent filter
live_test: Traverse a multi-page result set; interrupt; resume; and check for gaps and duplicates.

minimum_evidence: Documented bulk export or complete API extraction path with retained identifiers
live_test: Export a representative customer dataset and verify counts; identifiers; timestamps; and relationships.

minimum_evidence: Published request limits; 429 behavior; retry guidance; and limit visibility
live_test: Trigger or simulate throttling and verify bounded backoff without duplicate work.

minimum_evidence: Documented timeout expectations; idempotency controls; or reconciliation method
live_test: Interrupt a write after submission; retry safely; and prove only one intended result exists.

minimum_evidence: Documented events; payload schemas; signature method; retry rules; and ordering guarantees
live_test: Validate a signed event; reject an invalid signature; replay a duplicate; and force a retry.

minimum_evidence: API activity records identity; tenant; operation; object; outcome; timestamp; and correlation ID
live_test: Run read and write tests; locate their audit records; and reconcile correlation identifiers.

minimum_evidence: API health or status visibility; incident communication; and supported escalation route
live_test: Locate current status evidence and open a non-urgent API documentation question through the stated path.

minimum_evidence: Non-production or explicitly authorized test path with representative permissions and data
live_test: Complete representative read; failure; throttling; webhook; and reversible-write tests without broad production access.

minimum_evidence: Authentication; errors; pagination; limits; webhooks; examples; changelog; and support ownership are documented
live_test: Give the documentation to an engineer unfamiliar with the product and record every blocking assumption.
